Questions

How do I order?

Fill in the request form or message us on WhatsApp. We’ll reply with options and a price.

How do I pay?

After you approve the quote, we’ll send payment details. Your order starts once payment is confirmed.

Can I personalize a gift?

Yes. Names, printed designs, photo frames and card messages are available on many items. Tell us what you want in the form.

Do you deliver?

Add the recipient’s address in the form and we’ll confirm delivery availability, timing and fee.
